title: MSHvSF Saturn hardware budget and measurement ledger
scope: Platform capacities, measured disc storage, and open runtime peaks
budget_rule: Platform capacity is not runtime usage. On-disc package size is not decompressed or resident size. No fit claim is valid until destination, lifetime, overlap, and peak are traced.

capacity_provenance.kind: Pinned emulator memory-model constants, not MSHvSF runtime measurements
